title: Comparative Framework Discovery Program
mission: Build a structured, cross-domain evidence corpus of frameworks, case studies, postmortems, retrospectives, comparative studies, failures, adaptations, and outcomes so that Framework Engineering hypotheses can emerge from evidence.
evidence_strategy: Prefer primary sources; preserve conflicting and missing reports explicitly.
limitations: No real corpus execution has yet validated this profile.
next_execution: One real, source-preserving provider execution followed by an independent second-provider execution.
